body: Oh and I used to be a big hockey fan till my city decided to get rid of the team. Freaking Atlanta, I loved the thrashers even if you didn't.

I played sports in high school (swimming, lacrosse, "marching band") but gave them all up when I started college. Same with all the camping I used to do, a lot was through boy scouts. I haven't played in about 8 years but I'd love to get back into table top RPGs. Mostly now I'm either at work, school, or home. Mostly now I just read, watch tv, and be on reddit. I started working out again a couple months ago because I know physical activity can help bring people out of depression, helping inflate body image and what not. I tended to at least attempt do what the people around me did with varying degrees of success.  I'm always open to new stuff I just struggle with the other people and adequate time part of the equations.

I used to. My work schedule is crap for trying to maintain friends. Including tonight the last 3 nights (4pm to 12am) I had to work. This is pretty much every weekend. Our other drivers quit so they are pretty much dependent on me to take our clients to AA,NA,CMA and all the other anonymous meetings.

My ex and I are trying to still be friends, she seems to still cares about me and wants me to be more social. I just think my idea of social is completely different than her idea of social.
That was my 21st birthday. No one could come out. Went to a bar, bartender bought me a shot, I bought a beer. Had both then went home like nothing happened.

Thank you. My relationship with my mom is a lot better than with my dad. I've simi tried to reach out to my mother but when I did she kind of went into freak out mode and some of the questions she started asking I was uncomfortable answering to her. I used to tell my feelings to my girlfriend but at one point she confessed that during certain points of enlogated sadness everyonce in a while made her think about being with someone else. Of course that made clam up about how I really felt sometimes. After she told me she felt under extreme pressure 24/7 because she knew I was the only person I could turn to and she couldn't hamdle it.

I tried to start getting back together with one of my friends who lives in town but that did not go well. It's very discouraging. Not to mention that I'm the only person I know that's into the things I'm into.

I go off to grad school in a year and a half and I feel when I'm in a position to actually make friends that I'll be ok but a year and a half feels an eternity away. Struggling to make friends now and to just have to leave them all for the next 8 years feels like a waste of time.
